svg.title: Workflow of Neitzel et al. 2025
svg.desc: A pipeline of shapes, left to right: a simulated galaxy seen face-on and edge-on with the Sun's viewpoint; four sample clouds, two sharp and two blurred by errors; five feature rulers feeding one bundle; UMAP collapsing the bundle into a two-dimensional cloud, then a trustworthiness gate; HDBSCAN drawing two hulls, MC1 and MC2, with persistence bars above a baseline; a second run splitting MC1 into two and MC2 into three; and a three-by-three confusion grid with its diagonal filled, where the galaxy's own record arrives along a dashed return line.
